relationships.subject: EPZ6438
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological blockade of EZH2 by EPZ6438 or genetic silencing in GABAergic interneurons reverses morphine tolerance.

relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: GABA levels were reduced in the CSF of patients receiving morphine treatment compared with controls

key_findings: Chronic morphine suppresses TRPC5 in spinal GABAergic interneurons via EZH2/H3K27me3 at the Trpc5 promoter, reducing Ca2+ influx and GABA release.
TRPC5 activation by riluzole or overexpression in GABAergic interneurons prevents morphine tolerance; TRPC5 inhibition or knockout accelerates it.
